en.html:
I ran toward the place named in the message.
Run. Run. Run.
Time had passed. Far too much. How many hours since Muramasa was taken?
The sun slanted. The sky began to redden.

Safe. Still safe. She must be. Whatever Sorimachi wanted, he had no reason to kill her.
So she was safe. I believed it.
Even with communication still cut off. No response however often I called.

Alive. Surely. Certainly. Without fail.
So hurry. One second sooner. To Muramasa. To save her.
Run—

Sorimachi"That's right."
Sorimachi"Easy to understand..."

Sorimachi"Now... you're trying to kill me because you want to."
Sorimachi"That's right..."
Sorimachi"Wasn't like that before."
Sorimachi"Killed unwillingly..."
Sorimachi"Always, wasn't it?"
Sorimachi"Disgraceful..."
Sorimachi"Kill somebody... then cry, wanting to say you never really wished to."
Sorimachi"Then don't do it. Everyone you killed would tell you that."
Sorimachi"Should've taken your cursed sword and shut yourself away somewhere..."
Sorimachi"Instead you came barging out. For the world, to save more people—some mission nobody asked for. Killed against your wishes. Cried."
Sorimachi"Worthless."
Sorimachi"Kill people on your own initiative, then pity yourself..."
Sorimachi"Sickening."
Sorimachi"Makes me vomit."
Sorimachi"Now you're good."
Sorimachi"Good face."
Sorimachi"Hate and hate, want to kill so badly you can't bear it. A killer's face."
Sorimachi"Should've killed everybody like that."
Sorimachi"...Those Emishi kids too!"
